Stair down to the river of night
rivalry: bound to them by an ancient oath
obstacle: Stone door sealed with a priest's clay seal. The seal-stamp is in another room. Forcing it takes time and makes noise.
Ramp of slick, sand-polished stone. Without rope or spikes, mice risk exhaustion or falling.
Burial chamber whose only exit is a shaft in the centre of the ceiling, 6" from any wall.
Ka wailing inside the walls. Each Turn spent here or in adjacent rooms gives a Frightened Condition.
Sand-fall blocking the corridor, leaving a gap too small to crawl through.
Passage completely flooded with black water.
Deep drift of fine sand. Gives an Exhausted Condition per 6" traveled.
Long, polished granite ramp sloping upward.
trap: Stone block that slides shut behind the mice when the offering is lifted, then the ceiling starts pouring sand.
Floor of balance scales: step on the wrong pan and bronze darts fly from the walls (d8 damage, DEX save for half).
Sealed chamber thick with ancient resin vapour. Sweet, cloying smell. d20 damage if ignited.
Thin linen thread stretched across a burial shaft. Safe if crossed slowly, one at a time.
Pit blocking the way. A sacred asp is asleep at the bottom.
Three canopic jars with animal-headed lids: one safe, two hold curses. Opening a cursed jar deals d12 magical damage.
Ring of drifting ka-lights with a young mouse inside. Those within beg others to step in and stay forever.
Floor freshly coated with sticky resin. Requires a STR save to break a foot loose.
puzzle: Golden scales with a feather on one pan. Treasure is released only when the other pan is balanced exactly.
Three alabaster ointment jars of different colours. Each is inert alone but powerful or dangerous when mixed.
A block of natron with a magic sword sealed inside. It is very hard, but dissolves in fresh water.
Treasure is at the bottom of a deep burial shaft.
Large bronze offering bowl, upside down. Treasure is stuck to the inside of the bowl.
Door carved with a hieroglyph riddle: speak the right god's name to open it. A wrong name collapses the corridor behind you.

spells: Eye of the Sun
Shoot a ball of fire up to 24". Deal [SUM] + [DICE] damage to all creatures within 6".
Leave in the brazier of the Sun-Disk Sanctum for three days and nights.
Breath of Life
Heal [SUM] STR damage and remove the Injured Condition from a creature.
Cut self for d6 STR damage, sprinkle the spell with the blood.
Arrow of the Huntress
Deal [SUM] + [DICE] damage to a creature within sight.
Drop down a burial shaft at least 30ft deep. Touch the spell within one Turn.
Gaze of the Lioness
Give the Frightened Condition to [DICE] creatures.
Receive the Frightened Condition from a hostile creature while carrying the spell.
Veil of Night
Create a [SUM] x 2" diameter sphere of pure darkness for [DICE] Turns.
Leave uncovered in a sealed burial chamber for three days.
Waters of the River
Remove Exhausted or Frightened Condition from [DICE] + 1 creatures.
Leave in the flooded cisterns for three days.
Tongue of the Ibis
Make your meaning clear to [DICE] creatures of another species for [DICE] Turns.
Give away freely to a creature of another species.
Ghost Scarab
Create an illusory scarab that can carry 6 inventory slots for [DICE] x 6 Turns.
Bury in the scarab catacombs for three nights.
Sun-Disk
Force [DICE] creatures to make a WIL save or become stunned. Alternately, create light as bright as a torch for [SUM] turns.
Catch in the first light of a sunrise and the last light of sunset through a light well, for three days.
Ring of Balance
Creates [DICE] x 6" ring of force. It is invisible and immovable. Lasts [DICE] Turns.
Build a bronze ring the same size as last cast. Pass the spell through it. Dissolves the ring.
Opening of the Way
Open a door or container, as if a Save were made with STR score of 10 + [DICE] x 4.
Seal in a coffin, inside a coffin, inside a coffin. Leave for three days.
Embalmer's Oil
Cover [DICE] x 6" area in slippery, flammable oil. Creatures in the area must make a DEX save or fall prone.
Soak in embalming resin. Leave until it hardens.
Colossus
Grow a creature to [DICE] + 1 times its original size for 1 Turn.
Leave on the head of a colossus for three days.
Hidden Name
Make creature invisible for [DICE] Turns. Any movement reduces duration by 1 Turn.
Go a day without opening your eyes once, while holding the spell.
Offering to the Cat
Turn object into an irresistible lure for cats. Lasts [DICE] Turns.
Give a temple cat a gift it truly desires.
